No more Gemini API: scans get product info, and the Ask Gemini button does the rest. Install it over 1.0.2; your data stays.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.3/Spectra.apk)**

### Scanning without an API key
- The Gemini and Claude API lookups are gone, along with their keys, models, Test key, lookup method and Brave key settings. Saved keys are deleted from the phone.
- A scan now gets the **name, brand, serving size and label values** from Open Food Facts and USDA, or the **name and brand** from UPCitemdb for barcodes those don't know.
- A scanned food with no nutrition data opens with **Ask Gemini** and **Paste answer** at the top.
- **Paste answer** fills a missing name, brand or serving size from Gemini's "Product:" and "Serving size:" lines. Names and brands you already have are kept.

### Diary
- **Copying a meal or food to another day keeps its order.**
- **Reordering foods** (long-press and drag) now slides the other foods out of the way smoothly, and the lifted food stays visible.

### Food icons
- New **Herbs & spices** icon (basil, paprika, cinnamon, black pepper, seasonings and more).
- **Poultry** icon is now a chicken.
